mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, content, sort_order, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM devlogs WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at ASC
SELECT id, user_id, title, content, sort_order, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM devlogs WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO devlogs (user_id, title, content, sort_order) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE devlogs SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE devlogs SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
